product: Variant shredding will soon be enabled by default on new Variant tables
tagline: Starting November 18, 2026, Databricks will automatically add the variantShredding table feature to new tables that contain a column of the VARIANT type when they are created on Databricks Runtime…
what_it_does: Starting November 18, 2026, Databricks will automatically add the variantShredding table feature to new tables that contain a column of the VARIANT type when they are created on Databricks Runtime 17.3 or above. Variant shredding stores frequently accessed fields in a typed, columnar layout to improve query performance. This is a breaking change for Databricks Runtime 15.4: clusters running Databricks Runtime 15.4 can't read from or write to tables that have variant shredding enabled.
why_it_matters: Variant shredding stores frequently accessed fields in a typed, columnar layout to improve query performance.
